description: Assembled is a workforce management platform for customer support teams that provides automation, forecasting, scheduling, real‑time staffing controls and performance analytics. Teams can adjust schedules on the fly, rebalance workloads and keep service levels on track with granular visibility into queues and channels.
tagline: Workforce management platform helping organizations scale customer support.

description: Banner builds software for real estate owners and developers to manage capital projects end‑to‑end, including bidding, bid leveling, cost tracking, and reporting. It centralizes communications, workflows, and project data so stakeholders can coordinate decisions in one place.
tagline: Automating the real estate capital process, from bidding to reporting.

description: Basata offers an end-to-end agentic platform for healthcare administrators, automating the operational workflows that keep practices running — referral processing, intake coordination, call handling and patient follow-up. It replaces fragmented, manual processes with a single system where tasks that once took days, resolve in minutes.
tagline: Giving healthcare admin teams superpowers.
founders: Kaled Alhanafi, Chetan Patel, Vivin Paliath

description: Beeble provides AI‑assisted post‑production tools that extract high‑quality VFX passes and compositing assets from source footage. The system produces outputs such as depth, normals, relighting and other passes to support modern visual effects workflows.
tagline: Bringing cutting edge visual effects (VFX) to indie creators.

description: BNTO is the ultimate fashion rental subscription, offering the most coveted styles from both popular and up-and-coming global brands and designers, allowing renters to curate their own monthly BNTO boxes.
tagline: Automating supply chains for new, used and rental fashion.

description: Clearly AI is an AI-powered security and compliance co-pilot that automates design reviews, threat modeling, privacy impact assessments, and risk documentation so teams can ship secure products faster without bogging down engineers in manual reviews.
tagline: Automating security and privacy reviews.

description: CuspAI develops AI systems to accelerate the discovery and design of new materials for applications such as carbon capture and energy. Its platform uses machine‑learning models to search vast materials spaces and propose candidates with target properties.
tagline: Foundation models for molecular and materials discovery.

description: DataGrail is a privacy automation platform that helps organizations comply with regulations such as GDPR and CCPA. Capabilities include data discovery and mapping, data subject request workflows, and privacy assessments.
tagline: Data privacy software simplifying compliance with GDPR and CCPA.

description: DataLane is the real-time identity and intelligence platform for local businesses, creating a unified source of truth across fragmented online and offline data. By resolving business identities across platforms, DataLane enables teams to accurately understand, reach, and transact with the real-world economy.
tagline: Growing outbound revenue for businesses selling to SMBs.

description: Dataro provides an AI fundraising intelligence platform for nonprofits that predicts donor behavior and recommends campaigns to improve revenue. Tools include automated prospect research and donor segmentation.
tagline: Institutional fundraising platform supercharging development.

description: Daydream automates the creation and implementation of growth marketing playbooks for the world’s fastest growing companies.
tagline: End-to-end automation of programmatic SEO.

description: Drata is a modern GRC and compliance automation platform that unifies controls, risks, and audits while automating evidence collection. It supports frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA through continuous monitoring and integrations with cloud and SaaS systems.
tagline: Security and compliance automation platform built for enterprise.

description: Elicit is an AI research assistant that searches, summarizes and extracts data from scholarly literature to help researchers complete reviews and answer technical questions. It provides workflows for screening papers, synthesizing findings, and extracting structured information.
tagline: AI research assistant analyzing the world’s research.

description: Entire is building the world’s next developer platform where humans and AI agents collaborate together. Entire serves developers and engineering teams looking to get the most out of their agents, without sacrificing speed or quality.
tagline: Developer platform built for human and agent collaboration.

description: Ergeon is a technology‑enabled home services company focused on outdoor projects such as fences, gates, concrete driveways, patios and artificial grass.
tagline: Transforming home improvement with automation from design to delivery.

description: FarmWise builds AI and computer‑vision equipment for precision weeding in specialty crops. Their team is enabling growers to rethink farming operations with machines and technology that can perceive, understand, and act on each and every plant in real-time.
tagline: Autonomous weeding helping farmers reach productivity and profitability goals.

description: FerretDB is developing an open source, MongoDB-compatible document database. Their solution lets users interact with FerretDB just like as if it would be MongoDB.
tagline: Open Source MongoDB alternative, built on Postgres.

description: Flint is an AI-powered learning platform designed for K–12 schools that personalizes education for every student.Built in collaboration with educators, Flint helps teachers adapt lessons in real time, engage every learner and foster creativity across subjects — from math and science to world languages and writing.
tagline: Personalized learning built for schools.

description: Hallway develops a virtual‑camera app that lets people appear as animated avatars anywhere.
tagline: 3D Avatars that extend the digital identities of creators.

description: Imbue builds AI systems and tools that make software creation accessible so individuals can create, modify and control the software and agents they use. The company focuses on computing tools that give people more direct agency over AI systems.
tagline: AI agents that can reason and code.

description: Internet Backyard is building the financial backbone of the compute economy -- automating quoting, billing, payments and financial workflows for compute providers, enabling scalable, transparent, and tradable compute supply.
tagline: Financial operations for data centers.

description: Leaping AI provides enterprise voice agents for automating call center operations. Its agents handle common customer interactions, integrate with policy and account systems and hand off to humans when needed.
tagline: Automating complex call centers with voice AI.

description: Mem0 is a memory infrastructure platform that gives AI applications the ability to remember, retrieve, and evolve information across interactions. The platform provides developers with APIs and SDKs for storing and syncing user context across models, agents, and environments, enabling persistent and personalized AI experiences.
tagline: Memory for LLMs, enabling rapid deployment of personalized apps.

description: Momentum is an AI‑native revenue orchestration platform that turns conversations and meetings into structured go‑to‑market data. It updates CRM fields in real time and synchronizes information across tools to improve pipeline visibility and reporting.
tagline: Automating sales workflows and improving time to close for every deal.

description: Neion Bio uses genetic engineering to produce medicines in chicken eggs instead of massive industrial factories, dramatically lowering the cost of drug manufacturing.
tagline: A Better Way to Make Medicine.

description: Norm builds regulatory AI agents that deliver proactive compliance checks inside enterprise workflows. The agents evaluate proposed content or actions against relevant laws and firm policies and explain the basis for each determination.
tagline: Regulation-aware AI agents built for compliance teams.

description: Nuro is transforming everyday life by bringing the power of AI into the physical world with its fully autonomous Nuro Driver.
tagline: Pioneer in AI-first autonomy, revolutionizing mobility for all.

description: OpenArt is a platform dedicated to AI art enthusiasts. For a very long time in human history, art was a specialized technique mastered by minority. However, the foundation of art is all about expressing creativity and imagination, which is something everyone should be empowered to do.
tagline: Comprehensive visual storytelling platform, redefining who can create.

description: Parasail is a scalable, high-performance AI compute platform designed to make inference fast, cost-effective and infrastructure-free. The platform lets AI teams move from prototype to production without DevOps bottlenecks, with access to serverless endpoints, dedicated instances and batch pipelines powered by high-end GPUs.
tagline: Faster GPU clouds at 1/5th the price, coupled with LLM deployments.

description: Path Robotics develops autonomous robotic welding systems that use computer vision and AI to fit, adapt and weld parts without manual programming. Path helps manufacturers navigate skilled labor shortages, to increase production and scale their businsses.
tagline: Autonomous welding and manufacturing robots.

description: Quill is an AI-driven meeting intelligence and workflow automation platform that captures detailed notes, identifies key insights and drives meaningful follow-ups across teams’ everyday conversations. Rather than just transcribing, Quill organizes discussions into structured summaries, highlights blockers and automatically generates action items, tasks and contextual outputs that integrate with users’ tools and processes.
tagline: Private and secure enterprise knowledge.

description: Quince is democratizing high-quality fashion. The company's ultra-efficient supply chain and cutting-edge technology allows it to offer products at much lower prices than competing brands.
tagline: Democratizing luxury goods through its direct and automated supply chain.

description: Rasa provides open‑source and commercial software for building conversational assistants in text and voice. Developers design pipelines for intent classification, entity extraction, dialogue management, and integration with messaging channels.
tagline: Conversational AI software for building text and voice-based assistants.

description: Reflow is an enterprise workflow intelligence platform that makes operational work observable by turning complex human and system workflows into structured data, helping leaders visualize where work actually happens, identify bottlenecks, and measure the ROI of automation and optimization.

description: Rowspace is an AI platform that helps investment and financial services firms turn fragmented proprietary data into structured, decision-ready intelligence. The system unifies memos, models, deal records, accounting systems and unstructured archives, reconciles inconsistencies and embeds a firm-specific reasoning layer that mirrors how teams actually think and make decisions.
tagline: Specialized intelligence for investors to make faster, sharper decisions.

description: Sakana AI is a research company developing nature‑inspired methods for training and improving foundation models in Japan. Sakana AI continues to push the frontiers of AI innovation, devising new techniques for more efficient foundation model development.
tagline: Research lab creating nature-inspired AI.

description: Seen Health is an AI-powered PACE platform that unifies medical care, home-based services, social programs and transportation through intelligent scheduling, predictive insights and automated follow-ups. Staff receive real-time visibility into participant needs, enabling proactive interventions and smoother coordination across clinical and community settings.
tagline: Full-stack senior care, improving health outcomes with end-to-end technology.

description: Simular develops AI agents that can perceive screens, reason about tasks and act on a user’s computer. The product includes an AI browser‑automation experience for operating desktop apps and websites.
tagline: Personal AI agents on digital devices.

description: Single Origin is an AI-powered data semantic platform in multi/hybrid cloud that reduces compute and storage while boosting productivity at scale. It unlocks unique insights of column usage and inter-query patterns powered by its proprietary query compiler and parser.
tagline: Optimizing SQL semantics with one-click.

description: Slope is a B2B payments platform that provides embedded capital and a reusable line of credit for buyers. Businesses can offer net terms and installments while accepting online payments through software and APIs.
tagline: B2B payments infrastructure and access to capital through AI underwriting.

description: Snappr is a visual content platform that provides on‑demand professional photography, high‑volume editing and automated content workflows for businesses.
tagline: Democratizing professional visual content for every business.

description: Solvely is an AI study companion that provides step‑by‑step solutions to homework problems from photos or typed input across subjects from K‑12 to graduate level.
tagline: AI agents for learning to deliver adaptive, personalized, and joyful education.

description: With Spice AI, developers no longer need to be data or AI/ML experts to build intelligent, data and AI-driven software. We are helping every developer utilize and compose the latest AI/ML technology and infrastructure, so they can build the next generation of applications.
tagline: All-in-one modular and scalable AI infrastructure.

description: Spuree is an AI-powered animation platform that streamlines production workflows by automating storyboarding, character and asset creation, motion stylization, rendering prep and scene composition. Creators can iterate on shots in real time, test alternative takes instantly and move fluidly between tools without manual conversions and cleanup.
tagline: Animation tools powered by character performance foundation models.
